popCulture.title: Medea
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' tragedy makes Medea murder her children by Jason — Pheres (with Mermerus) among the Corinthian sons whose deaths seal the poisoned-gift plot against Creon and Glauce.

popCulture.title: Pheres
popCulture.description: Son of Jason and Medea — carefully distinct from Pheres son of Cretheus, Admetus' father; the Corinthian child of the poisoned robes.

popCulture.title: Mermerus and Pheres
popCulture.description: The paired sons of Jason and Medea — Pausanias and others keep their Corinthian tomb as the children's memorial after the murder.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: Pheres' father — the hero whose Corinthian remarriage costs him the children Medea kills in revenge.
